name: chem-2way-openseat
about: Dev holds the full Tu/Th 9:00 lecture and wants Mon/Wed. Eli holds Mon/Wed and wants Tu/Th 9:00. Dev's target still has open seats, so Dev goes first with ASU's atomic Swap, which frees the seat Eli wants. Nobody has to drop.
seat_override_note: #11989 is set to full so that Eli cannot simply switch on his own. #17344 keeps its real count from the fixture (open seats).

reasons.CHM 113: I want Tu/Th free for my research job.
